title: Original-era N64 2D interface references
scope: Ten distinct original Nintendo 64 games. No ROMs, generated mockups, remasters, replacement assets or deliberately enhanced renders were used.
method: Raw published image bytes retained. Capture hardware, VI and prior resizing are often undocumented. Treat these as design references, not proof of native framebuffer texel size or original hardware output.

references.title: Pokémon Stadium
references.capture_note: Published 300×225 JPEG, already resized by source. Hardware / VI / scaling unspecified. Western Stadium (JP Stadium 2); distinct from the Japan-only 1998 Stadium.
lessons: Give separate lists their own heading and aligned count columns.
Use a filled selected row and an obvious directional cursor.

references.title: Pokémon Stadium 2
references.capture_note: Published 300×225 JPEG, already resized by source. English N64 library UI; hardware / VI unspecified.
lessons: Warm paper, colored tabs and one active list create a strong physical metaphor.
Reserve a predictable area for the selected move or card description.

references.title: Paper Mario
references.capture_note: Published 640×480 JPEG, Japanese N64 UI with black border. Hardware / VI / resizing and retail-versus-press build unspecified. Use for hierarchy, not exact glyph measurements.
lessons: Make names, vital statistics and category tabs visibly different sizes.
Broad low-contrast paper checks give personality without fine grain behind text.

references.title: Ogre Battle 64
references.credit: Nintendo promotional screenshot, RPGamer June 2000 E3 group; Quest / Nintendo / Atlus
references.capture_note: 640×480 publisher-supplied original-era English localization press screenshot. The source labels its June 2000 group Nintendo. May precede final English retail; not hardware VI proof.
lessons: Split persistent character state, the actionable list and the effect comparison into regions.
A solid blue focus band, hand cursor and semantic comparison colors keep dense data readable.

references.title: Quest 64
references.capture_note: Published 920×670 JPEG of original N64 UI, rescaled/cropped. Hardware / VI / filtering unspecified. Use for composition, not native pixel measurements.
lessons: Pair a large selected-item symbol with a short effect description.
Opaque panels and a small cast shadow separate text from a busy scene.

references.title: Hybrid Heaven
references.capture_note: Published 579×443 crop/rescale, original N64 status UI in a modern retrospective. Pipeline unspecified. Author discusses original Expansion Pak high-resolution mode; do not infer a 320×240 text budget from this sample.
lessons: Large numeric values on dark backing keep vital statistics prominent.
A restrained cyan / amber / white vocabulary assigns colors a clear job.

references.title: Mario Golf
references.capture_note: Published 640×480 PNG from original N64 ending sequence. Hardware / VI / scaling unspecified. Use for emphasis and materials.
lessons: Give a result one large score, a strong headline and a recognizable reward symbol.
Broad wood and bold outlined numerals provide period character without sacrificing hierarchy.

references.title: Mario Tennis
references.screen: Transfer Pak character slots and commands
references.credit: Super Mario Wiki / Wildgoosespeeder; Nintendo / Camelot
references.capture_note: 304×222 PNG. File history explicitly says cropped from a 320×237 N64 screenshot to remove black border. Hardware / VI unspecified. No additional resampling here.
lessons: Paired character slots and arrows make relationships clear without extra prose.
Bright active commands and subdued unavailable icons need distinct, consistent states.

references.title: Pokémon Puzzle League
references.credit: VGMuseum / Rey; Nintendo / NST / Intelligent Systems
references.capture_note: Published 640×480 PNG from N64 gallery. Hardware / VI / scaling unspecified. Original N64 UI, distinct from Game Boy Color Puzzle Challenge.
lessons: Let one large portrait or card illustration accompany a clear list instead of illustrating every row.
Keep A/B glyphs and short command labels together in a predictable corner.

references.title: Mario Party
references.capture_note: Published 640×480 PNG from original N64 ending sequence. Hardware / VI / scaling unspecified. Not the Superstars remake.
lessons: Aligned portraits, symbols and numerals communicate several resource counts compactly.
One large ordinal establishes the result before secondary numbers are read.
